## Healthy Hair for the Holidays: Your Guide to Holiday Hair Gifts


It’s never too early to start shopping for holiday gifts. Whether you’re looking for white elephant gift ideas, beauty stocking stuffers for your family, or gift sets for coworkers, OLAPLEX holiday gift sets or[in-salon services](https://olaplex.com/blogs/news/why-you-need-olaplex-in-every-salon-service) can go on anyone’s list. From thoughtful hair gifts to an OLAPLEX gift set for someone special, there’s an option for every haircare lover.


## Holiday Haircare Gift Sets


[OLAPLEX® Hair Sets](https://olaplex.com/collections/olaplex-kits) are here to make holiday shopping easy for you. All OLAPLEX holiday gift sets are unisex—everyone needs to treat themselves, and the gift of a healthy hair routine is the best way to do that. Each of these gift sets is also ideal for all hair types, so if you’re looking for a curly hair gift set or a gift set for[wavy, straight, or coily hair](https://olaplex.com/blogs/news/how-to-determine-hair-type-and-texture) , you’ve come to the right place. Whether you’re shopping for curly hair gift sets, gifts for curly hair, or a hair care gift set for her, there’s an OLAPLEX set to suit their routine.


## If They Like Stronger, Healthier Hair


### Total Hair Repair Set


For the person who is always talking about hair health, choose a set focused on strengthening and repairing the look and feel of damaged hair.


[Total Hair Repair Set](https://olaplex.com/collections/value-sets/products/olaplex-total-hair-repair-set) has everything you need for stronger, softer, visibly healthier hair. This OLAPLEX holiday set includes:


- [OLAPLEX Nº.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment](https://olaplex.com/collections/treat/products/olaplex-n-3plus-complete-repair-treatment-100ml) prewash to strengthen hair
- [Nº.4 Bond Maintenance™ Strengthening Shampoo](https://olaplex.com/collections/wash/products/olaplex-n4-bond-maintenance-strengthening-shampoo-250ml) , which is the perfect holiday shampoo to strengthen and hydrate hair
- [Nº.5 Bond Maintenance™](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-5-bond-maintenance-conditioner-us)[Strengthening](https://olaplex.com/collections/wash/products/olaplex-n5-bond-maintenance-strengthening-conditioner-250ml)[Conditioner](https://olaplex.com/collections/wash/products/olaplex-n5-bond-maintenance-strengthening-conditioner-250ml) to smooth and strengthen hair


### The Strength & Shine Set


Give the gift of stronger hair with[The Strength & Shine Set](https://olaplex.com/collections/value-sets/products/olaplex-strength-and-shine-set) . This haircare gift set includes:


- [OLAPLEX Nº.7 Bonding Oil™](https://olaplex.com/collections/styling/products/olaplex-n-7-bonding-oil-30ml) for instant shine and protection


## If They Like Shiny, Smooth Hair


Know someone who loves glossy, smooth-looking hair? Give them a styling duo designed to help create shine while protecting hair from heat.


### Iconic Stylers Set


Who doesn’t love shiny hair? The[Iconic Stylers Set](https://olaplex.com/collections/value-sets/products/olaplex-iconic-stylers-set) contains two key products for shinier, smoother hair and heat protection:


- [Nº.6 Bond Smoother®](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-6-bond-smoother-us) to smooth, hydrate, reduce breakage, and provide heat protection
- [OLAPLEX Nº.7 Bonding Oil™](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-7-bonding-oil-us) for instant shine and protection


### The Key To Shine Set


[The Key To Shine Set](https://olaplex.com/collections/value-sets/products/olaplex-the-key-to-shine-set) contains a trio of mini OLAPLEX Nº.7 Bonding Oils™ plus a limited-edition keychain for effortless, high-shine hair that travels with you.


- An exclusive keychain to keep your glow within reach


## If They Like Hydrated Hair


For the person who is always looking for softer, more hydrated-feeling hair, choose a set that makes moisture the star of their routine.


### The Hydration Heroes Set


[The Hydration Heroes Set](https://olaplex.com/collections/value-sets/products/olaplex-hydration-heroes-set) is the perfect way to give your loved ones hydrated, healthy-looking hair with every wash. This healthy hair set contains:


- [Nº.4 Bond Maintenance™ Strengthening Shampoo](https://olaplex.com/collections/wash/products/olaplex-n4-bond-maintenance-strengthening-shampoo-250ml) to strengthen and hydrate hair
- [Rich Hydration Mask](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-5-bond-maintenance-conditioner-us) to smooth and hydrate hair


## Give Them an OLAPLEX Experience


Gift cards are an excellent way to support your local[OLAPLEX certified stylist](https://olaplex.com/pages/certified-stylists) . Purchase a gift card from a stylist for a variety of OLAPLEX salon services, from the ultimate[Stand Alone Treatment](https://olaplex.com/blogs/news/why-you-need-a-stand-alone-treatment) to a full-on transformation! Can't decide? Here's a little rundown of each service so you can decide which one will wow them! ****


### OLAPLEX Stand Alone Treatment


The ultimate OLAPLEX treatment uses Nº.1 and Nº.2 in the salon to rebuild the hair internally, resulting in stronger, healthier, more resilient hair.


### Color Service with OLAPLEX: Highlights, Balayage, Lowlights, and More


This service includes steps Nº.1 and Nº.2. Nº.1 is mixed in with the color or lightener to mitigate the damage done during the chemical process. Nº.2 then comes in to rebuild the hair, resulting in gorgeously shiny, healthy hair color.


### Texture Services with OLAPLEX


If waves, curls, or sleek tresses are on their mind, consider gifting the Bond Shaper® Curl Rebuilding Treatment. This professional treatment repairs, rebuilds, and redefines natural curls without perming agents, silicone, or protein. It even controls frizz through 15 washes.* ****


Make the holiday season more magical with OLAPLEX. Explore[all OLAPLEX products](https://olaplex.com/collections/all-products) to get more gift inspiration, or[shop OLAPLEX kits and value sets](https://olaplex.com/collections/value-sets) to find the perfect hair gift set.

*Clinically proven.
